hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | xargs -I{} npx prettier --write '{}' 2>/dev/null; exit 0

hooks.prompt: Check if source files were modified in this session by running `git diff --name-only HEAD`. If no source files changed (only CLAUDE.md, docs, or config), return ok:true. Otherwise: 1) Run `pnpm --filter client exec tsc --noEmit` 2) Run `pnpm run lint` 3) Run `pnpm --filter client test`. If ALL pass, return ok:true. If any fail, fix the issues and re-run until they pass.
